resumes.label: Quality Assurance
resumes.headline: Software Test Analyst / Quality Assurance (QA)
resumes.summary: Quality Assurance (QA) professional with hands-on experience validating enterprise resource planning systems (Nasajon ERP and TOTVS Datasul) and web applications. Work across the quality lifecycle: BDD / Gherkin scenario design; functional, exploratory and regression testing; retesting in staging environments; failure investigation through SQL and REST APIs; and End-to-End (E2E) test automation with Playwright, TypeScript, Pytest and GitHub Actions (CI/CD).
skills: Functional, manual, exploratory, regression and smoke testing; retesting; test plans and test cases; BDD and Gherkin; structured bug reports (evidence, severity and steps to reproduce).
Playwright (TypeScript / JavaScript); Page Object Model (POM); REST API testing (HTTP status codes, contracts and payloads); Pytest; Apache JMeter and BlazeMeter; CI/CD (GitHub Actions); Docker.
SQL (PostgreSQL, Supabase, SQLite); Python; TypeScript / JavaScript; Java; Next.js and React; Nasajon ERP (Finance, Services and HR); TOTVS Datasul ERP; RBAC.
Git and GitHub; Zendesk and Fluig; intermediate Microsoft Excel; AI agents applied to test engineering (Claude Code and Codex).

bullets: Perform functional, exploratory and regression testing on the Finance, Services and Human Resources modules of Nasajon ERP and on web applications in staging environments.
Validate complex business rules and customized deliveries for enterprise clients, reducing regression risks before production releases.
Investigate root causes, reproduce incidents and document detailed bug reports with evidence, preconditions and expected behavior; conduct thorough retesting with the technical team.
Standardize acceptance scenarios in BDD / Gherkin, monitor build health and contribute to continuous improvements in test automation processes.

Developed responsive interfaces (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Figma) and SQL database integration for audio playback and the catalog.

projects.title: QA Automation Suite: Playwright E2E, API & BDD

Conducted a practical bug-hunting study (teste-tecnico-qa-verzel) with exploratory sessions, evidence collection and isolation of real boundary-value and REST API contract defects (HTTP 422 vs. 200).
